pages.text: Flow through a fine vessel follows Poiseuille: Q = pi.r^4.dP / 8.eta.L, so halving the radius cuts the flow sixteenfold. The wall feels a shear pi.r.dP / 2.L.A; too much and it tears.
$(thing)Set$(): Vessel radius, Pressure.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Pulsing pump: the flow varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Too much shear: the vessel tears.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): More flow is faster.
